params.body:
## Why

A French dealer opened the relations page and read `ui.search_relations` in the search box: the key existed in `nl/ui.php` and nowhere else. It was not alone. Measured against nl, **fr missed 39 keys, en 85 and de 31**, and **24 keys the code asks for existed in no language at all** (the price table of the Spoticar order form, the attachment messages in settings, the subject line of the "new vehicle on the bidding list" mail).

Decided by Shane: every key in nl exists in fr, en and de, and a test keeps it so.

## What changed

**Guard: `tests/Feature/LanguageParityTest.php`** (pure file reading, no database, no framework boot)
- every key in `resources/lang/nl/*.php` exists in fr, en and de; the failure message lists the missing keys per language and file;
- every dotted literal key used with `trans` / `__` / `trans_choice` / `@lang` in `app/`, `resources/views`, `resources/js` exists in nl. Prefixes completed at runtime (`trans('warranty.state_' . $state)`) and `lbl.php` (built from the database) are out of scope;
- Spanish is a partial translation: the test reports it as incomplete, it does not enforce it.

**Filled**: 63 keys in fr, 109 in en, 55 in de, 24 in nl (the ones no language had, translated then into the other three). Tone follows the existing files (vous / you / Sie); brand names untouched. Existing translations were not changed, except:

**Eight French values with a stray article**, the machine-translation slip of the page title: `relation.relations` and `menu.relation` "des relations" -> "relations" (the page now reads "Relations"), `dealer.employees` "des employés" -> "employés", `algemeen.wachtwoord` "le mot de passe" -> "mot de passe", `order.price` "le prix" -> "prix", `vehicle.description` and `validation.attributes.description` "la description" -> "description", `validation.attributes.price` "le prix" -> "prix", `damage.Voorbumper` "le pare-choc avant" -> "pare-chocs avant".

Rule **R P2-2.10** in `docs/bedrijfsregels/32-p2-mijn-garage.md`, finding `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-vertaalsleutels-ontbreken-in-fr-en-de.md` (opgelost).

## Open points

- **es** misses 1,190 keys in the files it does have (vehicle 259, validation 222, global 136, ui 121, export 110, dealer 77, menu 48, user 29, order 26, email 24, stocklist 23, offer 21, option 20, website 19, algemeen 11, transport 10, worklist 9, action 5, settings 5, showroom 5, search 4, ownvehicle 3, vehicles 2, warranty 1). Not filled; the test reports the count.
- The legal texts of the Spoticar order form (statutory warranty, disclaimer, delivery formalities, engine-tuning declaration) were missing in fr/en/de and are now translated from the Dutch by this session. They deserve a read by Frederik before the French version lands on paper.
- `en/api.php` and `en/video.php` did not exist and were created.

## Tests

`vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'LanguageParity|Translation|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|CompiledViews|RulesDocsBuild'`: OK, 18 tests, 122 assertions, 1 incomplete (the Spanish report).
params.title: Every Dutch key exists in French, English and German, and a test keeps it so
